question: Which chapter of the Kāśyapa text concludes with the characteristics of the liṅga-born form?
premises: The text is attributed to Aṃśumān in Kāśyapa.
The chapter concerns the characteristics of the liṅga-born form.
inference: This marks the end of the eighty-first chapter on the liṅga-born form in the Kāśyapa text.
plain_english: Thus ends the eighty-first chapter, on the characteristics of the liṅga-born form, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
